`exact`: Every request gets the same routing, decision and bytes on the wire as under the KrakenD setting
`equivalent`: only JSON key order and whitespace, header casing and order, and gateway error bodies (`RZ-<AREA>-<NNN>`) differ
`approximate`: The Bundle validates and serves traffic; the report states each behavioral difference
`manual`: No automatic translation at this release; the behavior is absent unless the operator adds it
`manual`: Emits no resource for the setting, or a fail-closed hold for security controls
